_provenance.note: Hand-authored for issue #1257, mirroring github-issueList-state.json entry for entry. No live GitLab mirror is reachable from this environment, so the shape comes from the documented GitLab REST API v4 issues response, which carries `state` as opened or closed and the body under `description`. 911 opened (must become open), 912 closed, 913 no state key, 914 empty state, 915 an unrepresentable state; 921 a string description, 922 no description key, 923 a JSON null description, 924 an empty description.
